mobbin:5e3fe2a1-1087-4372-94f7-927aa2a82.summary: From My Templates library, the user opens a row's more menu, chooses 'Duplicate', and sees a new '(Copy)' row plus a 'Template duplicated' message.
steal: 'Duplicate' is in each row's menu, so you can copy a template without opening the editor.
The new row is renamed automatically with '(Copy)' at the end.
The Visibility column ('Just me', 'Community In review') stays in view while you duplicate.
mobbin:5e3fe2a1-1087-4372-94f7-927aa2a82.fit: Scenario manager: add a one-click duplicate from the library, so faculty can start from an existing scenario instead of a blank form or a Word import.

mobbin:4b33f07a-4b03-4b2f-aea9-b6d64bb52.summary: From the library row menu, the user opens 'Edit visibility', picks Team, Community or Only me, saves, and sees 'Community In review' plus a success message.
steps: Library: 'Edit visibility' in the row menu
Visibility pop-up: Community with highlight on
Saved: 'Community In review' plus success message
steal: Three cards set access: Team (can use, not edit), Community, and Only me.
The Team option says plainly that team members can use the template but not edit it.
Choosing Community shows an 'In review' label on the list after saving, because the community is moderated.
A 'Highlight your contribution' switch decides whether your name is shown publicly.
avoid: Publishing to a public community of all product users is wrong for Essentials, which needs sharing by organization and role, not a global template marketplace.
mobbin:4b33f07a-4b03-4b2f-aea9-b6d64bb52.fit: Scenario manager: the best nearby model for simpler sharing per scenario (private, team can use only, or a moderated organization library) instead of today's unclear SCE access.
